output.summary: A deciduous tree or shrub considered under a recent definition to be native to most of Europe, parts of Asia and northern Africa. It has paired leaflets and clusters of creamy-white flowers followed by red fruit; the bitter raw fruit is commonly debittered by freezing, cooking or drying before being made into preserves, drinks and other foods.
output.edibilityNote: Bitter raw fruit is usually frozen, cooked or dried, then made into preserves, juice, alcoholic drinks, tea, flour or savoury accompaniments.
